newsitem.title: USA: Value Health rejects MedPartners bid.
newsitem.headline: Value Health rejects MedPartners bid.

text.p: Value Health Inc, which revised its proposed merger agreement with Columbia/HCA Healthcare Inc, said it received and rejected an offer from MedPartners Inc.

The MedPartners offer called for each outstanding share of to be exchanged for 1.112 shares of MedPartners common stock in a tax-free transaction accounted as a pooling of interests, Value Health said.
In rejecting the offer, Value Health cited several factors, including a lack of a collar or other price protection, and the existence of conditions.
Value Health said the MedPartners proposal is contingent upon the negotiation of a definitive merger, final approval of MedPartners' board and the completion of due diligence by MedPartners.

"Based on the foregoing factors, among other things, the Value Health board determined that proceeding with the amended Columbia transaction, which provides for cash consideration to be delivered for each Value Health share, is in the best interests of Value Health shareholders," the company said in a news release.
